director.name: Mrs. Amarachi Ikonne
director.photoAlt: Portrait of Mrs. Amarachi Ikonne, Director of The Bridge Help Centre, smiling, in a black dress with a white beaded necklace
bio: Mrs. Amarachi Ikonne is a trained counselor and dedicated youth advocate with a passion for supporting young people as they navigate the challenges of growing, learning, and discovering their purpose. She has worked with teenagers and young adults for over 16 years.
She is a graduate of Mass Communication and holds a Diploma in Education and Counseling.

Through counselling, psychoeducation, mentorship, and advocacy, she supports children, adolescents, and young people in navigating life challenges, developing healthy coping skills, and reaching their potential. Her work is focused on helping young people grow into confident individuals who can live purposefully and contribute meaningfully to society.

story.imageAlt: A Bridge Help Centre facilitator in a red T-shirt with a full classroom of students in light-blue uniforms during a school outreach
paragraphs: For more than 16 years, our Director, Mrs. Amarachi Ikonne, has sat with teenagers and young adults in classrooms, counselling rooms and communities in Umuahia. Again and again, she met young people who were bright, curious and full of promise, yet carrying far more than any child should.

Some came from broken homes and had no one to talk to. Some sat in crowded classrooms without the teaching or support they needed to keep up. Others were already being pulled towards drugs, cultism, internet fraud, early pregnancy, or simply giving up on school. It was never a lack of intelligence holding them back. It was a lack of guidance, at the very moment they needed it most.

That burden stayed with her, and it became a vision: to reach young people early, while they are still young, and walk with them until they find their focus and direction in life. The Bridge Help Centre was born from that vision in Umuahia, to be a bridge between where a young person is today and who they can become.

What began in Umuahia has grown beyond it, and we have already reached more than 1,000 young people in schools and communities. We are only getting started. Our hope is to reach many more young people across Nigeria, so that no child with a bright mind is left to find their way alone.

vision: To be a leading organization dedicated to meeting the diverse needs of children, adolescents, and young people, helping them grow, thrive, and reach their full potential.
mission: To work collaboratively with parents, schools, and government partners to support, empower, and equip children and young people to thrive. We are committed to creating safe, inclusive, and nurturing environments by addressing their emotional, psychological, educational, and social needs with care, compassion, and professionalism, ensuring they are given equal opportunity to reach their full potential.
